wiki.title: Kenny Nguyen (politician)
wiki.extract: Kenny Van Nguyen (born 1994 or 1995) is an American politician and a Democratic member of the Colorado House of Representatives. Nguyen represents House District 33, which includes Adams, Broomfield, and Weld counties and was selected to fill the vacancy left by former state representative William Lindstedt who was appointed to fill the vacancy of his predecessor Faith Winter in the Colorado Senate.
